description: Convert a Gregorian date to the Hijri (Islamic) calendar using the Umm al-Qura tables, with month names in English and Arabic. The result is COMPUTED: the official UAE date is set by moon sighting and may differ by ±1 day, so data_confidence is 'medium'. Use for Hijri-dated documents and to estimate Islamic holidays. Example: {date:'2026-03-20'} → 1 Shawwal 1447 AH. Response always includes data_confidence ('high' = all dates officially announced/confirmed, 'medium' = something is estimated), estimated_items[], sources[] (official URLs) and data_version.
name: gregorian_to_hijri
title: Convert Gregorian → Hijri (computed)
